themes.name: Oil shock
themes.backdrop: Crude is trading near $100 (Brent above $115) on U.S.-Iran tension and Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities. Mediation talks can knock it lower fast, so this ripple flips direction with headlines.

chain.label: Crude oil
chain.why: The starting push. Every stage below reacts to its price.

chain.label: Oil producers
chain.why: Each extra dollar per barrel flows almost straight to profit.

chain.label: Drillers & tankers
chain.why: High prices pull rigs back to work. Shipping disruption lifts tanker day-rates.

chain.label: Petrochemicals
chain.why: U.S. makers use cheap ethane from natural gas, so pricier oil hurts their overseas rivals more than them.

chain.label: Paint & coatings
chain.why: Resins and solvents are oil-derived. Costs jump first and price hikes catch up a quarter or two later, so margins get squeezed in between.

chain.label: Airlines
chain.why: Jet fuel is their second-biggest cost, and hedges only soften the blow.

themes.name: Gas & LNG build-out
themes.backdrop: EQT agreed to buy Range Resources in a $50B+ all-stock deal, a bet on long-run gas demand from LNG exports and AI data centers.

chain.label: Natural gas
chain.why: The starting push.

chain.label: Gas producers
chain.why: Higher gas prices lift Appalachian and Haynesville producers directly.

chain.label: LNG exporters
chain.why: Long-term contracts make volume the story. Strong global demand supports new terminals.

chain.label: Fertilizer & chemicals
chain.why: Gas is the main feedstock for nitrogen fertilizer and U.S. ethylene, so pricier gas lifts their costs.

themes.name: 5% Treasury world
themes.backdrop: The 10-year yield is hovering near 5% after hot CPI and PPI prints. The Fed meets this week, and futures lean toward a December hike.

chain.label: 10-yr yield
chain.why: The starting push.

chain.label: Banks & brokers
chain.why: They earn more on deposits and cash sweeps when rates stay high.

chain.label: Insurers
chain.why: Premiums collected today get invested at higher yields.

chain.label: Homebuilders
chain.why: Mortgage rates follow the 10-year, which prices buyers out.

chain.label: Cash-hungry growth
chain.why: Companies still burning cash pay more to borrow, and their future profits are worth less today.

themes.name: AI build-out & power
themes.backdrop: Anthropic filed for a Nasdaq IPO, and Meta plans a $95B raise for AI infrastructure. At the same time, investors are questioning whether AI capex has peaked, so these names move together, in both directions.

chain.label: AI demand
chain.why: The starting push, tracked here through chip stocks.

chain.label: Chips & memory
chain.why: First in line for every new data-center dollar.

chain.label: Optical networking
chain.why: GPU clusters need far more fiber links than ordinary servers.

chain.label: Power & cooling gear
chain.why: Each AI rack draws 5–10x the power of a normal one.

chain.label: Power generators
chain.why: Data centers sign long contracts for always-on electricity, including nuclear.

chain.label: AI software small caps
chain.why: These ride sentiment more than earnings, so they swing hardest.

themes.name: Safe-haven gold
themes.backdrop: Gold is holding above $4,000/oz on geopolitical stress and inflation worries. Miners' costs barely move with it, so each extra dollar of gold mostly becomes profit.

chain.label: Gold price
chain.why: The starting push.

chain.label: Large gold miners
chain.why: Steady producers whose margins widen as gold rises.

chain.label: Mid & small miners
chain.why: Higher costs mean more leverage to the gold price, in both directions.

chain.label: Silver miners
chain.why: Silver tends to follow gold, with bigger swings.

themes.name: Defense & geopolitics
themes.backdrop: Reports say U.S. forces are ready to strike Iran if talks fail before the midterms. Defense backlogs were already at records.

chain.label: Conflict risk
chain.why: The starting push, tracked here through the defense ETF.

chain.label: Defense primes
chain.why: Multi-year contracts and record backlogs.

chain.label: Drones & missiles
chain.why: The fastest-growing slice of new orders.
